Dialogs.Dialog: Hehe, at that age where you want to be pampered？
Hehe. Do you get anxious if you're not touching me？
Hehe, what do you want to do？
It makes me go all limp.
Will you stay like this just a little longer？
Sorry. Just for a bit, like this...
This is kind of nice, I guess. Yeah.
Stay like that, stay like that... ehe.
Hehe, so you do things like that.
You like that kind of thing？
It's okay, you can be spoiled.
Yeah. I don't mind it, you know？
Geez... I'm going to get mad, you know？
No. I'm a girl, you know？
Sorry, can we not do that kind of thing？
I can't accept that, I guess.
Sorry, that kind of thing really is...
Um... that kind of thing is a bit...
Hehe. Do you think I'm enjoying this？
Hey, I'm not good with that kind of thing.
It's funny in a way... I guess？
Hehe. That's not very funny, you know？
Mmm. This is kind of nice.
Sorry. I don't really like that.
Geez, you'll mess up my hair.
Why would you do something like this！
Hehe, I'm in a good mood.
Keep doing that a little longer.
Um... I'll pretend I didn't see that.
I'm sorry... this is so embarrassing！
Let's not do that kind of thing. Okay？
Hmm... you've got quite a bit of muscle.
You want to act more like lovers？
You want to get closer？ Hm？
Isn't that kind of thing still too early？
Sorry, I'm not in the mood for that.
Do you have to be like this？
Oh my, you're surprisingly forward？ Hehe.
Hmm. So you do things like this.
Okay, okay. Don't squeeze so tight.
Okay. In exchange, hold on tight.
You can keep holding on forever.
Ah, sorry. That kind of thing... you know.
Um... do you have to do that？
It's hot. Maybe hotter than body temperature.
If we're not careful, we'll get sunburned.
Ugh～. I told you it's hot when you get close.
Even if it's hot, your body heat might be okay.
I want to eat something cold together.
Boys have it easy when it's hot.
Sweating might feel kind of good too.
Hot weather is the best chance to diet, just kidding.
Somehow... I can't feel my hands.
Ugh. It's too cold. I'm freezing.
Holding hands when it's cold feels nice, doesn't it.
I'm starting to miss my kotatsu.
Won't you come closer？ Here, snuggle up...
Your hands are cold. Want me to hold them？
Somehow, even though I'm scared... I'm excited.
There won't be... ghosts or anything, right？
No. It's dangerous if you move.
It's okay, right？ I'm right here with you.
It's a little scary, but... if we're together, right？
I don't mind. I don't mind, but...
Sorry. That doesn't make me happy.
Is it okay if I hang on your arm？
If you're too close, it's hard to walk.
Maybe we could get a little closer... maybe？
Let's stop that... okay？ It's embarrassing.
Huh？ Are you embarrassed？ Hey, hey.
Hey. Do you want me to snuggle closer？
I told you it's hot if we stick together.
Somehow I'm all sticky with sweat...
Um, is that enough？ Not yet？
What？ So you don't get lost？
Yes, yes, big sis is your chaperone.
Hello？ Isn't your gaze drifting down？
Oh no... where are you looking？
Don't keep looking at a place like that.
Why do you keep looking there？
Is that all you ever think about？
Ah. It might smell like mothballs.
Are you okay？ Isn't it hard to walk？
This is kind of nice. Isn't it？
Am I in the way？ Is it okay？
I kind of... like this. Maybe.
I wonder how we look to other people？
It kind of feels like you have me all to yourself.
Ehehe. I'm going to squeeze you tight.
Mmm... do we have to link arms？
Right now is a bit... you know. Sorry.
Let's do it another time. Okay？
Huh？ Isn't your hand sweaty？ Hehe.
Yeah, it's fine. I won't let go...
You can hold tighter, you know？
It's kind of childish... so, a bit.
Nuh-uh, it's still too early. Okay？
This is kind of embarrassing, I guess.
It's okay if people see, you know？
Hmm. Aren't your tastes a little lopsided？
Don't keep looking at my feet.
If you keep looking down, you'll get a hunched back, you know？
Don't make such a lonely face, okay？
When can we see each other next...
Hehe. It's okay, I'm not lonely.
Ah... that makes my heart pound, you know.
It's okay. We'll meet again, okay？
Sad to part？ Hehe, next time, okay？
Um... I'm starting to not want to go home...
Huh？ Don't want to go home anymore？
Ehe. This feels like lovers, doesn't it.
If you link arms with me, I can't go home, you know？
Geez. That makes you kind of cute.
Ah, you're trying to keep me here. Maybe？
Ehe. Next time we meet, okay？
Yeah. Let's hang out together again.
Does that mean you don't want to let me go home？
Do you like touching my hair？ Hehe.
Why my forehead？ Not that I mind.
Why my forehead？ Not that I mind.
My arm？ Why？ Hmm, you like it, huh.
Our hands touching like this... is nice.
I like it when you touch my hair...
From where you touched my forehead, it feels like happiness spreads through my whole body...
Linking arms is fine, but the condition is you never let go for the rest of your life！ Just kidding.
Don't, when you touch my ear, I feel you way too much...
Hey？ Can I keep you locked in my arms forever？
Geez, a girl letting someone touch her hair is pretty special, you know？
My ears are hot... if I really get a fever, it's your fault, okay？
With that hand, keep hold of my heart forever too...
Huh, my forehead... it's kind of embarrassing, but I don't mind at all, you know？
What？ Does touching my ear feel nice？
Shall I squeeze your hand tight？ So my touch stays with you even after you get home.
Hey, my forehead's hot, right？ It's not a fever, it's because of you, okay？
Don't... when you grab my arm... I can't resist...
If only this hand never let go, and you stayed by my side forever.
